Kai (Eng): ping on canary escalation thresholds. Do we have a fallback model to auto-switch to?

Aaron (Eng PM): release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/17766
Use this blurb in the post:
- Adaptive batching: reduces unit cost for short sync requests by ~25%
- KV prefix sharing: reduces cold-start p99 by ~30%
- New routing: region-pref + cost-fallback
Jin (PMM): great. where's the benchmark dashboard? need p99 chart and raw numbers.
Kai (Eng): dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/bench/17766. i'll capture p99 vs baseline and export a png for the post.
Priya (Docs): canonical: https://docs.redwood.com/docs/serve/adaptive-batching. i've added anchors and a short troubleshooting + rollback snippet.
Marta (Marketing): inbound leads: HubSpot form id and webhook? We want enterprise leads to AE queue, trials to trial onboarding flow.
Aaron (Eng PM): HubSpot form id: 8948. Webhook: https://hooks.redwood.com/leadrouter/v1/ingest. Payload includes tags: [source: announce, tier: trial|enterprise]. Ops has auth token in header.
Priya (Docs): added quick-runbook commands to docs for rollback:
```bash
# rollback to fallback model
retool deploy --model v1.2-q4 --route adaptive-batching
```
Kai (Eng): canary schedule proposal: 5% for 10m -> 25% for 30m -> 100% if green. PagerDuty triggers at error_rate > 1.5% or p99 > baseline * 1.8. I'll attach the runbook and CI canary config.
